row.notes: Parses a livery/decal layout JSON (resource loaded via 0x143f393a0, param_3 = resource id): array 'decals' with per-decal uniqueId, id, mirrorLinkedDecalUniqueId, projectionAreaId, translation (vec), rotationAngle, scale; builds decal list into result param_2 (+0x18 count, +0x20..+0x30 data, +0x38 valid byte) via 0x141459ba0. Logs 'Unable to find value for %s in JSON' on JSON channel. Addon: custom livery/decal placement - feed own decal JSON (positions/rotation/scale/projection areas).
